timeline.narration: Patient positioned in supine. General anesthesia established. Surgical timeout pending.
timeline.danger_zone: Trocar insertion site, inferior epigastric vessels

timeline.narration: WHO Timeout executed. Patient identity, procedure site (gallbladder), and penicillin allergy verified.
Dissecting peritoneum over Calot's triangle. Critical View of Safety (CVS) being established.
timeline.visible_findings: Cystic artery identified; cystic duct isolated; mild venous oozing at the gallbladder bed
timeline.danger_zone: Common Bile Duct (CBD), Right Hepatic Artery

timeline.narration: Unexpected arterial clip avulsion causing rapid arterial bleeding near the cystic pedicle. Suction engaged.
timeline.visible_findings: Active pulsatile arterial bleeding near porta hepatis; field obscured by pooled blood

timeline.narration: Attracting force applied. Hemoclip placed on proximal cystic artery. Hemostasis achieved. Irrigation clear.
timeline.visible_findings: Cystic artery securely clipped twice; clear field; no bile leak observed

timeline.narration: Gallbladder extracted in endobag via umbilical port. Fascia sutured. Skin closed with subcuticular sutures.
timeline.visible_findings: Specimen intact in pouch; port sites clean and dry
